sections.position: Software Engineer | Full Stack, Systems, and IoT

profile.background: Based in Barcelona, I transitioned into software engineering and built a solid foundation through intensive training and hands-on delivery in production-like environments.
profile.current: I combine frontend and backend development with systems-level practice in C/C++, Linux, networking, and relational databases to build solutions that are practical and maintainable.
profile.skills: My daily work focuses on clean architecture, code quality, and shipping features that are testable, observable, and easy to evolve.
profile.collaboration: I work comfortably in collaborative teams, contribute through pull requests and reviews, and communicate clearly across technical and product discussions.
profile.future: My growth path is focused on stronger software design, distributed systems fundamentals, and long-term product ownership.
profile.goal: Open to challenging projects where engineering discipline and product impact matter.
